requirement: A running chat says what its turn waits on — another conversation's write, the previous request's changes being saved, the page being looked at — instead of only "Thinking for…"

oracle.ref: PR #1403 (fix); fix evidence: Plan #1403 item 10 (code read 16/10/2026): a write waits up to 100 s for another conversation's lease (lease-wait.mjs), the first write up to 120 s for the turn's open (writeReady), a turn that wrote up to 30 s for the visual check — the model works in none of them and the chat showed only "Thinking for…"
oracle.invariant: S1: marked once and unmarked once whenever it waited, even when a send throws; never marked for a free site. S2: whole seconds while it lasts, null after; the newer wait stays when the older ends; one record whichever copy asks. S3: the conversation reads 'previous' while the write waits, null once it went. S4: waiting {kind: lease, seconds: 7} for wait: true, null with nothing recorded; the plain answer has no waiting key. S5: [data-chat-wait=lease] "Waiting for another conversation to finish changing this site… 12 s" (never a name), gone when the turn ends with no more asks; nothing asked while idle; nothing drawn for no wait or a short one.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: the wait is marked once when the first refusal makes it wait, and unmarked when it ends, however it ends
a wait is read with its whole seconds, and gone once ended; ending twice is nothing
a newer wait of the conversation is the one shown; ending the older leaves it
whileWaiting marks the wait for as long as the promise runs, a rejection included; no session marks nothing
one record per process, whichever copy of the module asks (each plugin bundles its own)
a write waiting for the previous request to be saved is marked as that wait, and unmarked when it goes
the shipped plugin leases a running turn, holds a follow-up while draining, and tells its author
waitLine: a known wait long enough to look stuck gets its line; anything else none
readWait asks the held door with wait: true; a refusal, a foreign body or no answer is nothing
a running chat whose turn waits on another conversation says so, with the seconds; never who
an idle chat asks nothing; a running one with no wait, or a short one, draws nothing
